newsitem.title: USA: US Plains fed cattle market seen steady/firm-trade.
newsitem.headline: US Plains fed cattle market seen steady/firm-trade.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle markets early next week were seen steady to firm on ideas that at least one major packer could need live supplies following the New Year's holiday on Wednesday, feedlot sources said.
Most meat packers will be closed Wednesday.

Prices also could be underpinned by reports that this week's active sales kept feedlots extremely current and that any cattle held over into next week were unfinished and could use the extra days on feed.
Spillover support from the pork complex also could lift fed cattle prices, market sources said.
